errors.evidence: This description of the purple line's trend is incorrect. The figure shows a continuous decrease from 2025 to 2039, not an initial increase followed by a decrease. Furthermore, the stated end value of 65,000 Euro/MW is grossly inaccurate; the actual value in 2039 is approximately 42,000 Euro/MW.
The description states the purple line starts at approximately 63,000 Euro/MW, but the figure shows it starts at approximately 65,000 Euro/MW.
